items.rationale: Overvoltage from lightning is covered under 2.3.3 and the speakers were physically damaged. No endorsement waives the surge-protection duty, so the 50% reduction applies if no protective device was used. Case 1 shows that a halved price level applies, and the speakers are priced below the TV.
Delivery of replacement property is not a repair cost under 7.1.8(b).
Fitting and installing replacement property is excluded under 7.1.8(c).

The TV was physically damaged by the lightning overvoltage and is covered under 2.3.3. Case 1 indicates a halved indemnity because no surge protection was used, giving a price level of roughly 300-450.

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics
items.rationale: This charge relates to a liability and property arrangement, which is excluded by 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).

items.description: Property and liability damage to electronics - service order
items.rationale: Placing an order under a service arrangement is excluded by 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f).
The attendance charge is on an invoice whose work is not indemnifiable, so it is excluded under 7.1.8(d).
